title: Product Overview - Hire your ideal candidate 20x faster while saving 10x time, money, and efforts with Xobin.
text:
Who We Are
Xobin is building one of the world most trusted online assessment software for pre-employment testing and job skill assessments. We are revolutionizing the recruitment screening landscape by combining the power of technology and automation.
If you have ever been a part of high volume campus recruitment, coding test or psychometric tests, there is a good chance that it was driven by Xobin.
We serve customers with pre-hire screening tests and psychometric tests in functions like Technology, Marketing, Finance, Hr & Ops. Our software enables over
600+ growth stage companies
to screen, shortlist and interview the right applicants.

1.5 million applicants

120,000+ questions

Scheduling phone screening rounds won't ever be a concern again. Xobin's Automated Video Interview Software uses
AI based scoring
